text.en: Clients frequently highlight how content and relaxed their rabbits and guinea pigs return after boarding. Pet parents appreciate that pets settle in comfortably, gain healthy weight during longer stays, and enjoy dedicated indoor quarters along with spacious outdoor garden runs.

Reviewers praise Charlie and her family for offering exceptionally warm and accommodating pet sitting. Owners note that she takes detailed instructions about daily routines, makes space on short notice during emergencies, and treats every visiting animal like a cherished guest.

Owners consistently mention the reassurance provided by frequent text check-ins and photographs while away. Clients value receiving snapshots of their rabbits enjoying garden adventures and treats, which gives them reassurance and confidence that their pets are thriving.

q.en: Which pets can board at A Furry World?

a.en: The service specialises in small animals including rabbits, guinea pigs, and rodents, alongside home cat sitting visits.

q.en: Are updates provided while owners are away?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly receive message updates and photographs showing their pets relaxing and exploring during their stay.

q.en: Can the team accommodate emergency bookings?

a.en: Reviewers note that Charlie is very accommodating with short-notice requests and emergency bookings whenever space permits.

q.en: Where is A Furry World located?

a.en: The service is based on City Road in Islington, providing care across Central and North London.
